Count Zu Heltzer wishes you to aid the Kurzicks in their defense at [[Fort Aspenwood]].

==Quest information==
===Objectives===
* Travel to [[Fort Aspenwood (Kurzick)|Fort Aspenwood]] and speak to [[Master Architect Gunther]]. 

===Reward===
* 3,000 [[Experience]]
* 250 [[Gold]]

==Walkthrough==
Leave House Zu Heltzer via the [[portal]] into [[Ferndale]]. Slowly [[pull]] the [[patrol]]ling Mantids to the initial shrine where the NPCs will assist you in fighting them. Once they are dead, head northeast, being wary of the [[Stone Spores]] enviromental effect, past [[Urkal the Ambusher]], killing the Dredge monks first.  Continue east across the wide flats, avoiding [[Mungri Magicbox]] if you do not have the ability to kill a strong monk boss.  [[Aspenwood Gate (Kurzick)]] lies ahead, and through this outpost you can access Fort Aspenwood.  Talk to Master Architect Gunther to receive your reward.

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Count zu Heltzer
:''"If you really wish to help the Great Houses, <Character name>, then travel to Fort Aspenwood. Master Architect Gunther is building a secret weapon there known as the Gods' Vengeance. Despite our best efforts to keep knowledge of this weapon from our enemy, it appears the [[Luxons]] have discovered our plans. Word has reached us that one of their great leviathans was sighted traveling to Fort Aspenwood with the intent of destroying Gunther's weapon.''

:''Please, head to '''Fort Aspenwood''' immediately and speak with '''Master Architect Gunther''' when you arrive."''
{{offer dialog
|accept = Fort Aspenwood will never fall!
|decline = It's a lost cause.
|ask = Really, this seems a rather inappropriate time to make small talk. '''Master Architect Gunther''' is in '''Fort Aspenwood''', and he needs your help! 
|indent = :: }}

===Reward dialogue===
;Master Architect Gunther
:''"Count zu Heltzer sent you. Well, we can definitely use the extra help. Thank you for coming."''

==Notes==
